This workspace is a team folder for a data analysis workshop. Follow the rules in RULES.md at all times:

- Use only files inside this workspace folder and its subfolders.
- Do not search the web, fetch URLs, or call any online service.
- Do not read, list or search files outside this workspace folder, including other teams' folders.
- If a task seems to need anything outside this folder, say so and ask the user instead of doing it.
